`true`: do nothing, successfully.

## Synopsis

<strong>true</strong>

## Description

<strong>true</strong> does nothing and exits with status 0. Any arguments are ignored.

<strong>sh</strong>(1) has <strong>true</strong> built in as well; this program is what runs when it's called by path or from another program.

## Exit status

Always 0.

## See also

<strong>false</strong>(1), <strong>sh</strong>(1)
